description: This source file contains JavaScript functions related to password management in the SuiteCRM application. It includes functions for password confirmation, validation rules, setting focus on input fields, and password strength checks.

methods.name: password_confirmation()
methods.description: Validates that the new password and confirm password fields match and updates UI styles accordingly.

methods.name: set_password(form,rules)
methods.description: Validates password change form fields, including administrator privileges and password matching, before submission.

methods.name: newrules(minpwdlength,maxpwdlength,customregex)
methods.description: Checks password strength against multiple rules such as length, character types, and regex patterns, updating UI indicators.

methods.name: set_focus()
methods.description: Sets focus on the appropriate input fields based on form state, primarily on password fields or user info fields.
